title: MEIKO — Use A Rabbit As A Springboard?!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: Use A Rabbit As A Springboard?!（4★）

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... What should I do for my next show?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Being able to bond with the audience during shows up to this point has been nice, but I kind of want to make this one a little more special...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Aren't there any good ideas out there...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah, I can do something moon viewing themed!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It'll definitely feel special too since it's going to be so different from what I usually do♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But as much as I want to start working on this idea, I really don't know much about moon viewings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Maybe I should ask Minori and the girls about this.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There. Our moon viewing stream should be all set to go now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Your ideas were so well-thought-out too, Shizuku. This is sure to become a fun stream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, Shizuku, you did an amazing job!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you♪
I wouldn't have been able to do this without all your help.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hi, girls, do you have a minute?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-MEIKO?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. Sorry for the surprise visit. There's something I'd like to ask all of you.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ask us? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Well...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <So I was wondering if you girls could teach me what you know about moon viewings...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see. If that's the case, we'd be happy to help!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Really?!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. We were just having a discussion about some moon viewing segments that we'll be doing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It could even act as a mock rehearsal for us, so why don't you sit back and watch us for a little bit?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, I'd love to! Thank you.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll start with an introduction...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Great, thanks♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's believed that moon viewings first gained prominence in Japan during the Heian period.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<The Heian era...
That's around when the Pillow Book was written, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, exactly. And moon viewing originally began as an event that was celebrated by nobles.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: These exclusive parties mostly involved drinking sake, reading poems and playing wind or string instruments while riding on special boats.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It started gaining popularity amongst commoners during the Edo period.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But by this time, it'd turned into a traditional farming ritual.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, I see. So the actual purpose of the event evolved as time passed.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! What began as a series of events for celebrating the fall harvest became one really big party!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so interesting how this all came about.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And it kept evolving too. Now, we celebrate by presenting offerings in the form of dango and pampas grass.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How we celebrate moon viewing today is actually a rather recent development.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <That's so intriguing! I've learned so much already!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, rabbits are closely tied with moon viewings because of how they were portrayed in folk tales...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I believe that's about everything...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Do you think it'll help?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, I think so! Nobles, the harvest... I'm starting to get some good ideas already♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! That's great!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I'll try to work what I learned from you all today into my next show!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Thank you so much♪>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Alright, how do I go about this show?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I could wear something much more Japanese and... Oh, I could even try working in some traditional Japanese dances into my dance routine♪)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, MEIKO, have you decided what you wanna do for your show?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. Well...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You'll just have to wait until then♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No...! Can you give us a tiny clue...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'll make sure to let you know when it'll be, so I hope you'll be able to come by and see it♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Great! I absolutely promise to go!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll be looking forward to it, MEIKO!
